name: How does an FSBO consultation compare to hiring a full-service real estate agent?

mainEntity.name: How does an FSBO consultation compare to hiring a full-service real estate agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: An FSBO consultation provides expert advice and guidance for you to sell your home independently, whereas hiring a full-service agent means they manage all aspects of the sale. With a consultation, you retain full control and save on commission fees, but you are responsible for all tasks including marketing, showings, and negotiations. A full-service agent handles these for you, offering convenience but at a higher cost. The choice depends on your comfort level with managing the sale process and your willingness to invest your own time.
acceptedAnswer.description: An FSBO consultation offers advice for self-sellers to save on commissions, while a full-service agent manages the entire process for a fee.
